tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i rjes su/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ shrī ma hā ka lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ zhes pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ ro ru ro ru bi tiṣ+ṭha/ ba dhot+sī ka ma la rak+kha sī hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la/ bi kā la/ rā tri ta/ ḍoṃ bhi nī/ tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ rak+kha sī/ siṃ gha lī de wī sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod dbul/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug nag po chen po gdong bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ 'jig rten du dge legs rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing*/ mthun rkyen thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rdo rje gur sogs nas/ rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod do// ༈ /bshags pa byed na/ thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// 'khor ba'i 'dam rdzab nang gnas pa// thugs rje'i phyag gis 'dren mdzad cing*// ye shes bdud rtsis tshim mdzad pa// bla ma'i zhabs kyi pad+mor 'dud// sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi// dang por me tog phog pa yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud// thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin mchog /gdod nas thams cad bdag nyid gnas// thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// kye yi rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul// che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa// kun bzang he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug rdo rje'i gur// khyab bdag ston pa kye yi rdo rje yi// sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i srung ma mchog

/nag po chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo nam gru ma// srid gsum gnas pa'i dgra las rnam rgyal ma// lha chen de was mchod pa'i dpal ldan ma// ma lus mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo khyod la bstod// gang gi mthu stobs ye shes rdo rje yis// lha min bdud kyi dpung tshogs rab bcom nas// thub bstan lha dbang grong khyer skyong mdzad pa'i// gdong pa bzhi ldan nag po che la bstod// pu tra nag po ha ha'i bzhad sgra can// ral gri thod pas brgyan pa'i phyag gnyis kyis// gnod pa'i dgra bgegs ma lus tshar bcad nas// bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong mdzad khyod la bstod// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// bshags pa dngos ni/ me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar la/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral bran g.yog bka' stod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la zhu zhing gsol ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ mi shes pa dang*/ ma gus pa dang*/ bag med pa dang*/ snyom las kyi dbang du gyur pas/ rang bzhin dang bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba bgyis pa dang*/ dam tshig dang mi ldan pa dang*/ dam tshig ma dag pa dang*/ tshogs 'dres pa dang*/ spyod yul gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ bsnyen pa dang sgrub pa la ma brtson pa dang*/ srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams dus dus su ma mchod cing*/

ma gsol ba'i dbang gis sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams chag tu gyur pa dang*/ khyed rnams kyi thugs dang 'gal bar gyur pa ci mchis pa de dag thams cad spros med rnam par mi rtog pa'i ngang nas/ thugs rje dang mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi spyan sngar mthol lo bshags so// bzod par gsol lo// mkha' la sprin dengs pa'am/ rgya mtsho la rlabs zhi ba ltar/ nongs par spyad pa dang de'i 'bras bu thams cad med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig rab tu zhi bar gyur cig sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang*/ rta mchog rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'di dang*/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo dam pa dang bcas pa'i mchod pa 'dis/ dpal mgon khyad par can khyed rnams kyi thugs dam skong bar gyur cig bzhed pa 'grub par gyur cig re ba rdzogs par gyur cig de ltar gyur nas kyang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sngon gyi las las gyur pa dang*/ 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i nad dang*/ gdon dang*/ rims dang*/ bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ dgra dang bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ tshe dang dpal dang*/ 'byor pa dang dbang phyug phun sum tshogs par mdzad du gsol/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ khyed thugs gsang ba dam pa'i mdzod// dges pa chen po'i sgo phye nas/ dngos grub phrin las bdud rtsi yi// rgyun gyis bdag rgyud gtams par mdzod// lan gsum/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i sku'i dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// bzod par gsol lo// tshangs par stsal du gsol/

zhes brjod cing me tog gtor la phyag bya'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
